description_en: Queries the table statistics of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 查看集群的表统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-table-statistics --db-cluster-id amv-0000000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTableStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
按指定字段排序，JSON格式：JSON数组，有序，按顺序输入排列字段和升降序类型：

如：

```
[

    {

        "Field":"Name",

        "Type":"Asc"

    }

]
```

其中Field表示需要排序的字段名，目前仅支持对"Name" 字段排序。
Type表示排序类型 Desc为降序，Asc为升序

均不区分大小写
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The region ID

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html接口可以查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to query information by table name
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，支持根据表名模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

ColdDataSize.description_en:
The size of cold data. Unit: bytes.

This parameter is supported only for AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters of V3.1.3.4 or later
ColdDataSize.description_zh:
冷数据总量，单位：byte。
3.1.3.4及以上内核版本的集群支持该参数

DataSize.description_en: The data size of the table. Unit: bytes

HotDataSize.description_en: The size of hot data. Unit: bytes

IndexSize.description_en: The data size of indexes. Unit: bytes

OtherSize.description_en: The data size of other data. Unit: bytes

PrimaryKeyIndexSize.description_en: The data size of the primary key index. Unit: bytes

RowCount.description_en: The number of rows in the table

SpaceRatio.description_en:
The percentage of the table size. Unit: %.

Formula: Table storage percentage = Total data size of a table/Total data size of the cluster × 100%
SpaceRatio.description_zh:
表空间占比，单位：%。

计算公式为：表空间占比 = (表总数据量 / 实例总数据量) * 100

TotalSize.description_en:
The total data size of the table. Unit: bytes.

The following formulas can be used to calculate the total data size:

Formula 1: Total data size = Hot data size + Cold data size.
Formula 2: Total data size = Data size of table records + Data size of regular indexes + Data size of primary key indexes + Data size of other data
TotalSize.description_zh:
总数据量，单位：Byte。

总数据量的计算，以下2个公式都成立。

公式1：总数据量 = 热数据量 + 冷数据量。
公式2：总数据量 = 表记录数据量 + 普通索引数据量 + 主键索引数据量 + 其他

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
